scores.notes: The house behind the table is a stone and half-timbered Tudor cottage with tall chimneys on the left but a pale clapboard Victorian house with a columned porch on the right, and the table is bare wood on the left but covered with a white cloth on the right.

The tables under the big tree are alike, but the house behind is a pale plastered Georgian-style house with sash windows and a pedimented doorway on the left and a red-brick half-timbered Tudor house with leaded windows on the right.
Both show a ridged and furrowed green lawn enclosed by a low brick garden wall with clipped shrubs and tall trees behind, card-soldier hoops and hedgehogs on the grass, in the same soft daylight.

The house behind the table is a pale plastered house with sash windows and a pedimented door on the left but a red-brick, half-timbered tiled cottage with a gabled porch on the right, and the table has a patterned cloth on the left and is bare wood on the right.

Both show a rough, tufted green lawn inside a long pinkish brick garden wall with conifers and leafy trees behind under a pale cloudy sky; the hoops are white arches on the left and bent soldiers on the right, but the ground, wall and planting are compatible.

Both show a ridged, striped green lawn enclosed by a low brick garden wall with rounded shrubs in front and tall leafy trees behind, card soldiers bent as hoops and hedgehogs on the grass in the same soft daylight.

Both show a rough tufted lawn enclosed by the same long pinkish brick wall with dark cypresses and rounded leafy trees behind under a pale cloudy sky; hoops are white arches on the left and bent soldiers on the right, but the garden itself matches.

Both show a ridged, tussocky lawn enclosed by a low pinkish brick wall with trees behind and scattered small figures; left adds a topiary arch and right a foreground tree, compatible as different viewpoints.

Both show a table on a lawn under a massive oak in front of a half-timbered red-brick house with a tiled roof; the table is bare wood on the left and cloth-covered on the right and the house is closer on the right, but the house, tree and lawn agree.
Both show a lawn mown into ridges and furrows, enclosed by a red brick wall with shrub borders and tall trees behind; the layout is compatible from two viewpoints.

Both show a clothed table on grass under a large oak in front of the same kind of pale two-storey clapboard house with a posted veranda, shuttered windows and a panelled front door; the right shows a pediment and steps at the door from a more frontal view.

Table under a big oak on grass in both, but the house conflicts: left is a pale clapboard house with a long posted veranda and shutters; right is a steep-gabled stone and half-timbered cottage with tall stone chimneys and leaded windows.
